attr.title: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
attr.desc: Construct 2 / HTML5 build of Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider running on a bundled aarch64 WPE WebKit runtime rendered to the framebuffer.
attr.inst: Provide your own legitimate game assets (Steam AppID 1942010 / GOG) via scripts/extract-assets.sh. No assets are bundled.
